message.content: Describe the classify_thinking_block_excessive classifier from phase_a #548

content.text:
<thinking>
The classify_thinking_block_excessive classifier fires when a thinking block exceeds 2000 chars without a subsequent tool call. This is part of the phase_a5 classifiers in backend/run_analyst.py. The fixtures/transcripts/ directory contains test cases for each classify_ function. The d#548 Discussion spec defines the acceptance criteria for these classifiers.
</thinking>

The thinking_block_excessive classifier is defined in phase_a5 as part of the 8 new classifiers.
